summary: NETCONF connection variables can be set per task, for example ansible_private_key_file to use a different key; see ansible.netcommon.netconf for all options.
questions: How do I use a different SSH key for one NETCONF task?

answer_card.title: Per-task NETCONF variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: configure interface while providing different private key file path
  junipernetworks.junos.netconf_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_junos_location
  vars:
    ansible_private_key_file: /home/admin/.ssh/newprivatekeyfile
```
See the `ansible.netcommon.netconf` plugin docs for other variables.
